name: SanCCS
description_en:
SanCCS Cloud is SAN Softwares’ hosted contact-centre offering for inbound and outbound calling,agent routing,CRM context and performance monitoring. The assigned product page lists predictive,progressive,manual and preview dialing,missed-call callbacks,omnichannel options and scheduled reports. The navigation distinguishes hosted SanCCS from its on-premise version,office PBX,emergency coordination and TeamInspector products.

For an illustrative support operation,configure an IVR/availability route,assign agents,handle the interaction,record its disposition and review a report or quality sample. A report can be scheduled to named email recipients,which introduces a separate access boundary. The mobile agent app describes receiving calls via a mobile phone line,not proof that every call is an in-app data call. No account,campaign,call,screen monitoring,AI assessment,report delivery,payment or export was tested.
description_zh:
SanCCS Cloud是SAN Softwares托管联络中心，处理呼入／外呼、客服路由、CRM上下文及绩效监控。指定产品页列预测、渐进、手动和预览拨号、未接回拨、全渠道选项及定时报表；导航区分托管与本地SanCCS、办公PBX、紧急协调及TeamInspector等产品。

假设支持作业需配置IVR／可用性路由、分配客服、处理互动、记录处置，再查报表或质检样本。报表可定时寄指定邮箱，构成独立访问边界。移动客服说明经移动电话线路接听，不证明所有电话都是应用内数据通话。未测试账户、活动、电话、屏幕监控、AI评分、报表送达、付款或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Select dialing modes and ACD based on agent availability,category or skill.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按客服可用性、类别或技能选拨号模式及ACD。

core_features.explanation_en: Use colored dispositions,case assignment,agent scores and audit sampling with live dashboards.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合实时看板使用彩色处置、案例分配、客服分数及质检抽样。

core_features.explanation_en: Schedule one-time or recurring reports with To/CC,subject,body and condition matching.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以收件／抄送、主题、正文及条件匹配安排单次或周期报表。

core_features.explanation_en: Analyze recordings,metadata,chats,email and tickets against configured rules and scoring criteria.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按配置规则及评分标准分析录音、元数据、聊天、邮件和工单。

en: A support team coordinating remote agents,call routing and scheduled performance reporting.
A quality lead comparing rule-based audit samples with an explicitly scoped AI analysis module.
zh: 协调远程客服、电话路由及定时绩效报表的支持团队。
比较规则质检抽样与明确范围AI分析模块的质检负责人。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not verified productivity,accuracy,compliance or savings.

Remote agent path.en: Hosted offering reduces server hardware needs,but the agent still needs connectivity and a compatible device. Mobile app description routes customer calls through the mobile phone line.
Remote agent path.zh: 托管减少服务器硬件需求，客服仍需连接及兼容设备，移动应用说明通过移动电话线路接客户电话。

steps.en: Choose hosted SanCCS and confirm licensed channels,dialing,AI QA,carrier path,trial terms and actual order pricing.
steps.zh: 选择托管SanCCS，确认许可渠道、拨号、AI质检、电话路径、试用条件及真实订单价。

steps.en: Configure one queue,IVR route,agent availability and disposition;connect the chosen CRM with explicit field ownership.
steps.zh: 配置一个队列、IVR、客服可用状态和处置，以明确字段权威连接CRM。

steps.en: Pilot unanswered/no-agent calls,missed-call callbacks,quality scores and report recipients;verify data export before renewal or cancellation.
steps.zh: 试跑无人接／无客服、未接回拨、质检分数和报表收件人，续费或取消前验证导出。

items.en: Hosted/on-premise SanCCS and separate PBX,TeamInspector or emergency products are not one confirmed entitlement.
items.zh: 托管／本地SanCCS及独立PBX、TeamInspector、紧急产品不是同一已核权益。

items.en: Missed-call auto callback is listed without an attempt schedule,customer consent rule or success guarantee.
items.zh: 列未接自动回拨，但未给重试安排、客户许可规则或成功保证。

items.en: AI QA coverage,compliance and savings claims are not an independent audit or measured scoring accuracy.
items.zh: AI质检覆盖、合规及节省主张不是独立审计或实测准确率。

items.en: General terms mention10daytrial and INR billing but do not establish a SanCCS-specific amount,seat unit or trial scope.
items.zh: 通用条款提十天试用及INR计费，但未建立SanCCS专属金额、席位单位或试用范围。

items.en: Complete recording retention,exports,deletion guarantees,regional processing and a current product-specific SLA remain unverified.
items.zh: 完整录音留存、导出、删除保证、地区处理及当前产品专属SLA未核。

license.notes_zh: 通用软件／应用／服务授予有限个人、非独占、不可转移使用权，厂商保留知识产权；定制开发50%源码费用条款不证明会提供SanCCS源码。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 通用条款写INR加税、月／季／年自动续、十天免费试用及付款后不退。到期后需续或申请临时五天访问密钥，不是明确自动宽限。SanCCS Cloud专属金额、席位／通话单位、最低量、运营商／AI／集成费及试用资格未知。定制开发50%源码费另属范围，不是托管许可价。

faq.question_en: Does zero hardware mean no device or phone cost?
faq.question_zh: 零硬件就不需设备或电话成本吗？
faq.answer_en: The hosted offer avoids running the contact-centre server,but agents still need devices/connectivity. Its mobile app specifically mentions receiving calls over a mobile phone line;carrier charges were not established.
faq.answer_zh: 托管免自己运行联络中心服务器，但客服仍需设备／连接。移动应用明确提经移动电话线路接听，运营商费未建立。

faq.question_en: Does automatic QA prove every compliance requirement is met?
faq.question_zh: 自动质检证明满足全部合规吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The module evaluates configured scripts/rules and produces scores/alerts. Source completeness,transcription errors,policy correctness and human review still need validation.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。模块评估配置脚本／规则并输出分数／提示，来源完整性、转录错误、政策正确性及人工复核仍需验证。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.

sections.title_en: Select hosted SanCCS and the actual agent connection
sections.title_zh: 选择托管SanCCS及真实客服连接
sections.en:
The assigned page is SanCCS Cloud,a hosted contact-centre solution. Its navigation separately lists on-premise SanCCS,office PBX,hosted IVR,TeamInspector,AI products and emergency coordination. A feature listed elsewhere in the vendor portfolio is not automatically a hosted-plan entitlement. The documented onboarding sequence includes guided setup,channel integration,team training and go-live,so it is not evidence of an entirely self-service instant deployment.

Hosted operation reduces server hardware responsibility,but agents still need compatible devices and connectivity. The mobile app description says agents log in,set availability and receive calls via their mobile phone line. Confirm that carrier path,caller identity,cost and failure behavior before equating mobile access with an all-data softphone. No mobile or browser call was made.
sections.zh:
指定页是SanCCS Cloud托管联络中心，导航另列本地SanCCS、办公PBX、托管IVR、TeamInspector、AI及紧急协调。厂商其他产品功能不自动是托管方案权益。文档开通流程为指导设置、渠道集成、培训及上线，不证明完全即时自助部署。

托管减少服务器责任，但客服仍需兼容设备及连接。移动应用说明登录、设可用并通过移动电话线路接听，应先确认运营商路径、主叫身份、成本及失败行为，不能把移动访问等同全数据软电话。未执行移动或浏览器电话。

sections.title_en: Configure the route and verify the callback outcome
sections.title_zh: 配置路由并核对回拨结果
sections.en:
SanCCS lists ACD based on agent availability,category and skills,alongside IVR,time conditions,voicemail and forwarding. Outbound options include manual,preview,progressive and predictive modes. The auto-dialer page describes progressive dialing only when an agent is available,preview preparation before dialing and sequential power dialing. The reviewed pages do not establish exact ratios,attempt limits,abandonment calculations or machine-detection accuracy.

An illustrative customer-service pilot should include an unavailable skill,a closed-hours call,a full queue and a missed agent call. Missed Call Auto Callback is listed,but its timing,retries,who calls first and when an attempt counts as complete are not specified. Compare the saved multilevel disposition and case assignment with the actual customer result. DNC consent rules and lawful contact times remain implementation responsibilities rather than inferred guarantees.
sections.zh:
SanCCS列按客服可用性、类别及技能ACD，另有IVR、时段、信箱和转发。外呼包括手动、预览、渐进和预测，自动拨号页描述客服可用才渐进、拨前预览及顺序Power，但未建立具体比例、次数、弃接计算或答录机识别准确率。

假设客服试点应含无可用技能、非工作时间、满队列及客服未接。虽列未接自动回拨，时间、重试、先拨谁及何时算完成未说明。需比对保存的多层处置、案例分配与客户真实结果；DNC、联系许可及合法时间仍需实施，不能推断保证。

sections.title_en: Keep live coaching distinct from automatic quality scoring
sections.title_zh: 区分实时指导与自动质检评分
sections.en:
The monitoring page distinguishes listening,private whisper coaching,joining a live call,recording and screen monitoring. It also includes general features a business should look for,which is not proof that every hosted package enables all of them. Supervisor visibility and recording permissions should be tested separately from agent access.

SanAI QA describes ingesting recordings,CTI/CDR metadata,chats,email and tickets,then using speech recognition,language analysis,keywords,sentiment and configured policy/scoring rules. Outputs include scores,alerts,agent dashboards and reports. A score about script compliance is not independent certification of lawful behavior or a verified employee-performance judgment. Check incomplete recordings,transcription mistakes,wrong speakers and a misconfigured rubric with human reviewers before relying on all-interaction coverage or advertised savings.
sections.zh:
监控页区分监听、私下耳语、加入通话、录音和屏幕监控，也包括企业应寻找的一般能力，并不证明每个托管套餐全启用。主管可见性和录音权限应独立于客服访问测试。

SanAI QA描述采集录音、CTI／CDR元数据、聊天、邮件及工单，用语音识别、语言分析、关键词、情绪及配置政策／评分规则分析，输出分数、提示、客服看板及报表。脚本合规分不是合法行为独立认证或已核员工绩效判断。依赖全量覆盖及宣传节省前，需由人工复核录音不全、转录错误、说话人错误和评分规则误配。

sections.title_en: Treat CRM writes and report recipients as explicit data paths
sections.title_zh: 将CRM写入及报表收件人视作明确资料路径
sections.en:
The hosted product names more than20CRM integrations,including Zoho,LeadSquared,SugarCRM,Zendesk,Freshdesk and Dynamics365. The auto-dialer page describes syncing call logs,customer details and outcomes,but provides no connector field schema,retry contract or conflict-resolution behavior. An answered call should not be treated as a successful CRM write until the intended record is checked.

The Advanced Report Scheduler supports one-time,daily,selected-day,weekly,monthly and yearly delivery,with To/CC recipients,subject/body customization and condition matching. Test the reporting interval,time zone,filters and recipient permissions. A scheduled report may expose customer/agent data outside the workspace;delivered mail is not proof of a complete portable backup. Actual format,large-export limits,retention and delivery failure handling remain unknown.
sections.zh:
托管产品点名20多个CRM集成，包括Zoho、LeadSquared、SugarCRM、Zendesk、Freshdesk及Dynamics365；自动拨号页描述同步日志、客户资料及结果，却未给字段schema、重试或冲突处理。核对目标记录前，接通电话不能视为CRM写入成功。

Advanced Report Scheduler支持单次、每日、指定日、周、月、年送达，并可设收件／抄送、主题／正文及条件。应测时间范围、时区、过滤和收件权限。定时报表可能把客户／客服资料送出工作区，邮件送达不是完整可携备份；格式、大导出上限、留存及送达失败处理仍未知。

sections.title_en: General trial and renewal terms do not supply a hosted seat price
sections.title_zh: 通用试用及续约条款不提供托管席位价
sections.en:
SAN’s general software/app/online-services terms state INR billing plus applicable taxes and automatic monthly,quarterly or annual renewal. They describe a10dayfree trial and no refund after payment;after subscription/trial expiry,continued access needs renewal or a temporary five-day key supplied on request. This is not an automatically promised grace period. The exact application of these general terms to a SanCCS Cloud order,trial capacity and duration must still be confirmed. No fixed seat/call amount,minimum,carrier,AI or connector price was established.

The license is limited,nonexclusive and nontransferable,with vendor IP retained. A clause charging50%of development cost for custom-application source code is a different scope and does not establish source delivery for SanCCS. Terms instruct customers to archive content frequently and permit processing/storage in multiple countries. Complete export,recording retention,deletion and recovery were not verified. SanCCS is an editorial candidate for teams able to manage integrations,agent connectivity,quality review and reporting permissions.
sections.zh:
SAN通用软件／应用／在线服务条款写INR加税、月／季／年自动续，描述十天免费试用及付款不退。订阅／试用到期需续费或申请临时五天密钥，并非自动承诺宽限。通用条款具体如何适用SanCCS Cloud订单、试用容量及期限仍需确认；未建立固定席位／通话金额、最低量、运营商、AI或连接器价。

许可有限、非独占、不可转移，厂商保留知识产权。定制应用源码收开发费50%的条款另属范围，不建立交付SanCCS源码。条款要求客户常归档内容，并允许多国处理／存储；完整导出、录音留存、删除及恢复未核。编辑判断可供能管理集成、客服连接、质检复核及报表权限的团队评估。
